messages:
maria: Quick check — can we greenlight the commercial onramp for inference v1 today? Need signoff on SLA, docs, support rota, and pricing table.
josh: what's blocking? any outstanding compliance items or perf issues?
li: monitoring caught a long-tail mem growth in canary yesterday. we mitigated via cache evict, but need a permanent fix. PR ready: <link>/pr/472
rachel: docs mostly done except the pricing examples and the runbook step to escalate to platform oncall. pushing a PR now.
maria: finance — are the pricing tiers approved for public docs? @tom-finops
tom-finops: small ask: include a usage-cap example for Dedicated customers and a short note on custom pricing negotiations. otherwise ok. also need to confirm billing edge-case for burst-credit refunds.
ops-bot: [deployment-bot] Canary deploy started for inference/v1-canary at 09:14 UTC
josh: eng update: KV-cache patch merged to main; bench shows p95 latency within target for 8k seq load. canary scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 to validate on real traffic.
li: i'll add an alert for prefix-cache growth + a dashboard tile for blocked RPS. also preparing a fallback route policy incase memory climbs.
rachel: Support ask: we need a second oncall for 72h post-rollout for escalation. who's available to pair with sam?
sam: I can take the first 48h. happy to pair first day. @maria can you confirm rotation/comp?
maria: noted. I'll update the rota doc and add the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-v1
josh: Pricing docs snippet to include in the examples (feel free to copy into PR):
```
pricing:
  hosted: "$0.03 per 1k tokens"
  embeddings: "$0.02 per 1k vectors"
  dedicated: "commit-based tiers, contact sales"
  burst: "+20% surcharge over agreed RPS threshold"
```
li: obs: need to add a synthetic canary to detect warm-start regressions and an automated rollback hook.
maria: security — any compliance blockers? @alice-security
alice-security: need KMS integration proof and SOC2 appendix clause in the contract. ETA EOD today for comments. we'll flag any legal wording changes.
maria: if we get thumbs up from finance, security, and eng by EOD we'll move this to motion-to-greenlight. please add reactions for quick ack. :thumbsup:
